name: cao-agent-plugins-dogfood-recorder
description: Dev/CI tooling: shift-left dog-food recorder for the Agent Plugins pipeline. Runs the asserting run.sh (CAO installing its own `cao` package through its own plugin pipeline) and exports a gated proof-of-work GIF to docs/media/. A broken pipeline cannot print the PASS marker, so it cannot produce a green recording. Not required to use Agent Plugins.
